question: What do Coordinape, Opolis and Open Collective state about how they allocate resources among contributors or employ members cooperatively?

frame.population: DAO contribution-allocation tools and member-owned employment commons
frame.comparator: Tidepool member allocation and micro-enterprise accounts

findings.finding: Coordinape describes itself as "a platform for DAOs to easily and fairly distribute resources to contributors", where contributors reward the value they see created, with grants, salaries and projects as uses, and "No more cumbersome voting or black-box committees!". It links a gift-circles guide.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Coordinape is a platform for DAOs to easily and fairly distribute resources to contributors.

notFound: epoch length, GIVE allocation rules and any usage figures; the welcome page does not carry them and the gift-circles guide was not opened

findings.finding: Opolis is a member-owned employment cooperative for independent professionals: members hold ownership, earn $WORK tokens, receive dividends when declared and nominate candidates to a Board of Stewards; Employment Commons LCA is employer of record for Employee Members; community membership is a one-time 97 USD; employee membership needs an active S-Corp or C-Corp and brings semi-monthly W-2 payroll with group health and retirement benefits. Stated figures: "$210M+ Payroll Processed, 2020 - 2025", "1,150+ W-2s Issued, 2020 - 2025", all 50 US states and DC.
Open Collective is described as "an online funding platform for open and transparent communities"; the page routes groups without a legal entity or bank account to a fiscal host.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Open Collective is an online funding platform for open and transparent communities.

notFound: fiscal host fees, number of collectives and hosts, Open Collective Foundation dissolution: not on the page read

variables.q: Coordinape epochs GIVE gift circle docs

searches.reading: Only the welcome page was read.
Landing page only; Colony and Aragon were not searched.
